info.title: HOMI
info.description: HOMI API v1. Every response uses the `{success, data, meta?}` envelope; errors use `{success: false, message, code, errors?}` (ADR-0007, ADR-0017); every answer of a source method carries `meta.source` (`stub`, `legacy` or `native`), and cursor lists `meta.next_cursor` (docs/api/README.md). Authentication: Sanctum bearer tokens (ADR-0003). Collector intake: see docs/api/intake.md.

get.summary: Show a media file with its public or temporary URLs

delete.description:
The original, its variants and the record go with the last reference; while another owner
holds the file it stays readable for them.
delete.summary: Delete the caller's reference to a media file

post.description:
Stores the original under a content-addressed key and queues WebP variants; uploading the
same bytes again returns the existing media file and makes the caller one of its owners.

post.summary: Create a presigned PUT URL on the tmp disk
Register an object uploaded through a presigned URL as a media file

patch.summary: The stub validates and answers the fixture with the sent keys overlaid; nothing is stored

message.description: Human-readable summary; not for program logic.

Currency.description: The display currencies of the product. Prices in the reference data are whole USD whatever the user's currency.
Currency.title: Currency

Locale.description: The languages of `/api/v1` (CF-006: `uz` is the only Uzbek code on this surface; `uz_Latn` lives only inside the legacy driver).
Locale.title: Locale

key.description: Keys are issued by POST /media/presign as uploads/{owner_type}/{owner_id}/{ulid}.{ext}.

SourceDriver.description: Which implementation of a capability answered (ADR-0017): fixtures, the legacy service, or HOMI's own code. Written to every `/api/v1` answer as `meta.source`; the client's "demo data" marker reads `stub`.
SourceDriver.title: SourceDriver

StoreEventRequest.description:
`POST /events` (WP-11): `{name, props?}`. A `422` only for a missing or non-string `name` or a `props` that is not an
object. An unknown name, a name outside the pattern or unknown properties are accepted and not stored (WP-47 stores
the catalogue). The raw body is capped at 8 KB before anything else: over it, `413 payload_too_large`.
StoreEventRequest.title: StoreEventRequest

file.description: Content validation (MIME sniffing, dimensions) happens in HashedUploader.

TelegramSignInRequest.description: `POST /auth/telegram`: the raw `initData` query string of the Mini App launch, at most 4 096 bytes.
TelegramSignInRequest.title: TelegramSignInRequest

Theme.description: The colour theme a user chose; `auto` follows Telegram.
Theme.title: Theme

UpdateSettingsRequest.description:
`PATCH /settings` (WP-11): any subset of the six writable keys; unknown keys are ignored. A city must be one of
`GET /reference` (same driver, same scenario); quiet and digest hours must equal one of the presets of
`config/settings.php`.
UpdateSettingsRequest.title: UpdateSettingsRequest
